verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Zep publishing memory-quality benchmark results such as LongMemEval or LoCoMo, or any recall-accuracy figures. The performance docs cover only retrieval latency (sub-200ms), which is a speed claim and not a recall-quality benchmark. The community thread on Zep's move to graph memory describes poor recall in its earlier pipeline but cites no published benchmarks.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
